provenance: Thirty controller-captured AnalysisReports (26 analyst-set reports plus four coverage reports), plus the empty copy. Arabic 14, English 17 including empty_result. Rankings recomputed locally with Phase 3; no model calls.
rules: Captured reports are unchanged; empty_result copies deaths_by_gender and changes only result.rows and result.row_count.

Controller intents and acceptable lists are the floor. Add every recommend_charts candidate within one point of the top, computed with the controller intent and no suggestion, matching the notes ranking context. ChartAccepted measures this permissive type envelope; Passed and the human rubric remain independent.

Accept bar/column swaps (including grouped and stacked variants), pie/donut swaps, and tables for single-number results. For deaths_by_gender also accept pie and donut because the brief explicitly requires the two-part whole and a passing donut fixture.

Use the brief-required line suggestion for married_share_by_gender instead of the notes pie suggestion. Keep the notes dual_axes suggestion for orders_and_average_price_by_status as a second override case.
All cases have explicit brief intents; other brief fields are null or empty except the named suggestions and brand colors.

Bindings constrain roles shared by all accepted chart types, using the top candidate binding and the requested share where unambiguous. This avoids rejecting tables or alternate time/category roles. Variable-role and table cases rely on Passed and the human roles criterion; nationality stacks may bind counts with percent true or precomputed shares.

Emphasis is null throughout: no question names a plotted category to highlight. In particular, fines_by_district stays plain as the controller requests. The evaluator has positive and negative emphasis tests.
The seven-parts fixture has seven independent annual shares, not seven parts of one whole. married_share_by_gender also has independent denominators, so pie/donut remain rejected by H14.

The relation fixture has an ordinal birth_year, not two measures; no scatter is invented. The two-unit fixture orders_and_average_price_by_status has no declared units, so dual_axes stays rejected by H10. under_15_share_by_region supplies actual person and percent units.

Single-number questions retain their supporting result columns. nationality_share_within_region is category-by-group composition, not a temporal series; deaths_by_year_and_gender supplies actual time-by-group coverage.

The literal three-point envelope admits weak alternatives (including single-row scatter, raw-value table, and word_cloud for many categories); retain them as required and let the six-criterion human judgment decide appropriateness.

Acceptable charts (2026-09-07, controller): the controller's judged list as the floor, plus every candidate within one point of the top score that is not negative, plus the orientation and pie/donut swaps. The earlier three-point envelope admitted charts a person would reject.
deaths_by_gender keeps pie and donut: a two-slice pie of counts by gender is the design's two-part-share coverage even though the compare intent ranks columns first.

average_fine_by_violation_type.why: Intent: compare. long labels favour bar (S5)

citizens_by_trip_year.why: Intent: trend. two time points: line rejected by H7

deaths_by_gender.why: Intent: compare. code beside label: H13 keeps grouped charts out; bind gender_label Two-part share coverage from additive gender totals; bind gender_label instead of its code alias. Pie/donut are human alternatives for this whole.

deaths_per_month.why: Intent: trend. suggested chart followed: brief suggested_chart_type "line"

female_share_by_region.why: Intent: compare. per-region shares; not one whole

fines_by_district.why: Intent: compare. ten districts; emphasis case: the question can name one district in the brief? No: keep plain

married_share_by_gender.why: Intent: share. H14: each gender's own share; pie and donut rejected. Suggested chart overridden: brief suggested_chart_type "line" (brief takes precedence over notes) Two rows with separate denominators; suggested line overridden. Not a two-part whole.

nationality_share_within_region.why: Intent: composition. 24 rows, 4 columns; expect percent stacks or shares Group-shape coverage is category by group here; deaths_by_year_and_gender covers time by group. Counts with percent stacks and precomputed shares are both valid.

non_saudi_deaths_by_age.why: Intent: distribution. ordinal age bands, no raw values

orders_and_average_price_by_status.why: Intent: compare. two measures without units: dual_axes rejected by H10 even when the brief suggests it. Suggested chart overridden: brief suggested_chart_type "dual_axes" Two-unit question, but captured units are missing; do not invent them. under_15_share_by_region covers declared person and percent units.

orders_by_status.why: Intent: compare. brand colors case: brief brand_colors ["#1F4E79", "#C0504D"]

paid_share_by_year_since_2020.why: Intent: trend. seven years; a share over time Seven-parts coverage means seven independent yearly shares, not a single whole.

salary_vs_birth_year.why: Intent: relation. birth_year is ordinal, so scatter is impossible; 63 points

top_makes_by_average_fine.why: Intent: rank. averages: pie rejected by H3

unpaid_share_overall.why: Intent: share. single number with three columns

violation_type_share.why: Intent: share. five parts summing to 100; long labels

violations_by_district_many.why: Intent: compare. 55 districts: bar or column need `limit` and `sort value desc`; the rulebook says so

empty_result.why: Intent: compare. copy of deaths_by_gender with rows emptied Empty result expects clarification before any model request.

jeddah_monthly_injuries_and_deaths.why: The incident of 2026-09-09 (request rq_f5c12d15eb2a4bddbfd2783cba9e90d1): twelve months, injuries and deaths in persons side by side; the fold draws them as two series. Added with the fold; not one of the thirty captured reports.
